# IStargateRouter
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/interfaces/IStargateRouter.sol)

**Title:**
IStargateRouter

Interface for Stargate Protocol's Router, used for cross-chain token transfers

Based on the mainnet deployment at 0x8731d54E9D02c286767d56ac03e8037C07e01e98


## Functions
### swap

Swap tokens from source chain to destination chain


```solidity
function swap(
    uint16 _dstChainId,
    uint256 _srcPoolId,
    uint256 _dstPoolId,
    address payable _refundAddress,
    uint256 _amountLD,
    uint256 _minAmountLD,
    lzTxObj memory _lzTxParams,
    bytes calldata _to,
    bytes calldata _payload
)
    external
    payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstChainId`|`uint16`|Stargate chain ID of the destination chain|
|`_srcPoolId`|`uint256`|Source Stargate pool ID|
|`_dstPoolId`|`uint256`|Destination Stargate pool ID|
|`_refundAddress`|`address payable`|Address to refund excess fees to|
|`_amountLD`|`uint256`|Amount of tokens to swap in local decimals|
|`_minAmountLD`|`uint256`|Minimum amount to receive on destination in local decimals|
|`_lzTxParams`|`lzTxObj`|LayerZero transaction parameters|
|`_to`|`bytes`|Address bytes on destination to receive tokens|
|`_payload`|`bytes`|Additional payload to send to destination|


### quoteLayerZeroFee

Quote the LayerZero fee for a Stargate operation


```solidity
function quoteLayerZeroFee(
    uint16 _dstChainId,
    uint8 _functionType,
    bytes calldata _toAddress,
    bytes calldata _transferAndCallPayload,
    lzTxObj memory _lzTxParams
)
    external
    view
    returns (uint256 nativeFee, uint256 zroFee);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstChainId`|`uint16`|Stargate chain ID of the destination chain|
|`_functionType`|`uint8`|Function type (1 for swap)|
|`_toAddress`|`bytes`|Recipient address bytes on destination|
|`_transferAndCallPayload`|`bytes`|Payload for the transfer|
|`_lzTxParams`|`lzTxObj`|LayerZero transaction parameters|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`nativeFee`|`uint256`|Native token fee|
|`zroFee`|`uint256`|ZRO token fee (usually 0)|


### addLiquidity

Add liquidity to a Stargate pool


```solidity
function addLiquidity(uint256 _poolId, uint256 _amountLD, address _to) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_poolId`|`uint256`|Pool ID to add liquidity to|
|`_amountLD`|`uint256`|Amount to add in local decimals|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive LP tokens|


### instantRedeemLocal

Instantly redeem LP tokens for underlying tokens locally


```solidity
function instantRedeemLocal(uint16 _srcPoolId, uint256 _amountLP, address _to) external returns (uint256 amountSD);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_srcPoolId`|`uint16`|Source pool ID|
|`_amountLP`|`uint256`|Amount of LP tokens to redeem|
|`_to`|`address`|Address to receive underlying tokens|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amountSD`|`uint256`|Amount of underlying tokens received in shared decimals|


### redeemRemote

Redeem LP tokens remotely (cross-chain)


```solidity
function redeemRemote(
    uint16 _dstChainId,
    uint256 _srcPoolId,
    uint256 _dstPoolId,
    address payable _refundAddress,
    uint256 _amountLP,
    uint256 _minAmountLD,
    lzTxObj memory _lzTxParams,
    bytes calldata _to,
    bytes calldata _payload
)
    external
    payable;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_dstChainId`|`uint16`|Destination chain ID|
|`_srcPoolId`|`uint256`|Source pool ID|
|`_dstPoolId`|`uint256`|Destination pool ID|
|`_refundAddress`|`address payable`|Address to refund excess fees|
|`_amountLP`|`uint256`|Amount of LP tokens to redeem|
|`_minAmountLD`|`uint256`|Minimum amount to receive in local decimals|
|`_lzTxParams`|`lzTxObj`|LayerZero transaction parameters|
|`_to`|`bytes`|Recipient address bytes|
|`_payload`|`bytes`|Additional payload|


### createPool

Create a new Stargate pool


```solidity
function createPool(
    uint256 _poolId,
    address _token,
    uint8 _sharedDecimals,
    uint8 _localDecimals,
    string calldata _name,
    string calldata _symbol,
    address _router
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_poolId`|`uint256`|Pool ID to create|
|`_token`|`address`|Token address for the pool|
|`_sharedDecimals`|`uint8`|Number of shared decimals|
|`_localDecimals`|`uint8`|Number of local decimals|
|`_name`|`string`|Pool name|
|`_symbol`|`string`|Pool symbol|
|`_router`|`address`|Router address|

## Structs
### lzTxObj
Parameters for LayerZero transactions


```solidity
struct lzTxObj {
    uint256 dstGasForCall;
    uint256 dstNativeAmount;
    bytes dstNativeAddr;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`dstGasForCall`|`uint256`|Gas to use for the function call on destination|
|`dstNativeAmount`|`uint256`|Amount of native asset to send to destination recipient|
|`dstNativeAddr`|`bytes`|Address on destination to receive native tokens forge-lint: disable-next-item(pascal-case-struct)|
